narr: Low pressure moving eastward through the region brought heavy rain to southeastern Pennsylvania on the morning of September 6. Rainfall totals ranged from 2 to 5 inches in much of the area.
ev: East Barnard Street in West Chester was closed between South Matlack Street and South Franklin Street due to flooding. South Adams Street in West Chester was closed between East Market Street and East Miner Street due to flooding.
A water rescue took place on Conshohocken Road in Plymouth Township.
Minor flooding occurred along Cobbs Creek in Philadelphia.
Minor flooding occurred along Wissahickon Creek in Philadelphia.
Moderate flooding occurred along Frankford Creek in Philadelphia.
lsr: EAST BARNARD STREET WAS CLOSED BETWEEN SOUTH MATLACK STREET AND SOUTH FRANKLIN STREET DUE TO FLOODING.
FRANKFORD CREEK AT PHILADELPHIA CRESTED AT 8.73 FEET AT 852 AM. FLOOD STAGE WAS REACHED AT 830 AM.
WISSAHICKON AT WISSAHICKON CREEK REACHED FLOOD STAGE 912 AM.
